name: Powder Process-Solutions
old_description: Powder Process-Solutions has been providing innovative components and systems for powder handling since 1971.
about:
Powder Process-Solutions, based in Chanhassen, Minnesota, has been designing and manufacturing bulk powder handling equipment since 1971. The company traces its roots to Nu-Con Equipment and Boedecker Company before adopting its current name. Today it is led by President and Owner Mike Salvador and operates alongside a sister distributor, Powder-Solutions, Inc., which supplies BFM® flexible connectors, PSI-Pleat filters, and MAGNATTACK magnetic separators. The combined organization employs over 50 engineers, designers, and technicians.

The firm specializes in custom pneumatic conveying, mechanical conveying, packing and filling, mixing and blending, ingredient weigh batching, gassing, grinding and milling, central vacuum cleaning, dust collection, and process control systems. All systems are designed, fabricated, and assembled at its Minneapolis-area facility, which includes a fully equipped test lab for simulating powder behavior under real processing conditions. Projects range from individual components to complete turnkey lines installed across North America, Asia, and Europe.

Primary customers operate in the food, dairy, infant formula, and nutritional powder sectors; the company notes that many well-known brands of infant formula and coffee creamer pass through its equipment. It also serves medical technology applications requiring dust control. Testimonials reference dairy, food, and infant formula producers.

Powder Process-Solutions emphasizes an "engineering first" approach, adherence to USDA Dairy, 3-A Sanitary, and EHEDG hygienic standards, and 24/7 U.S.-based support. Its mission is to deliver quality, cost-effective food processing solutions tailored to each customer with a high level of personalized service.
